body.statement: For a fixed positive optimization penalty \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}\) in the regular interior assignment problem of Fang, Ridder, and Xie, their Theorem 2 gives the \(n\)-scaled penalized-regret limit as one half of the limiting optimizer error transposed against the negative criterion Hessian and itself.

source.locator: Theorem 2 in arXiv:2512.19230v3, unnumbered displayed penalized-regret limit

attestation.note: Retrieved directly from the primary arXiv v3 HTML and arxiv_version.tex source on 2026-09-15; Theorem 2 unnumbered main display.
